intent: Only pass a persistently followed slower independent vehicle when calm, not player-led/follower/convoy and no competing navigation/traffic hold.
Use observed/configured attainable speed and authored cap; require useful relative speed and finite projected pass duration/distance.
Follow actual road geometry; reject intersections, bridges, pedestrians, additional road traffic and oncoming traffic before lateral path issue.
Reserve one passing vehicle per slower peer; keep collision avoidance active.
Finish only after hull-length separation; abort early behind peer or reduce speed to fall behind when alongside before native-route return.

sourceBounds.activeBudget: estimated pass time * 1.8 + 5; abort BACK grants a separate 10 seconds; END retries route refresh up to4 seconds

departuresRequired: Public OvtBy object alone is not exclusive owner/epoch/episode consent and expiry.
Source fixed-path points force terrain-relative zero height; CBE requires actual supported surfaces/hull clearance.
Source forward/outer rays do not establish swept whole-body/terrain support safety or future lane availability.
Source path end and refreshRoute can rewrite native intent; use exact owned fixed-path retirement and unchanged authored route receipts.
Keep one original finite operation deadline across OUT/BACK/END, including owner migration; do not renew stage budgets by reconstruction.
World query results and road-segment evaluation require explicit density/work limits and measured overhead.
Do not globally ignore the overtaken peer in collision protection; lateral separated hull proof must qualify any following-cap exception.

implemented: Opt-in DrivingPassAdmission consumes existing traffic observation, eight-second sustained follow, bounded geometry/traffic preparation, owner consent and fixed original expiry.
DrivingAssistStart calls DrivingPassStep under existing sole cap/path owner; excludes competing corridor/bypass/reverse work.
DrivingPassStep implements OUT, DROP_BACK, RETURN_SCAN, RETURN_READY and RETURN with whole-hull separation, bounded support/traffic observations and exact order/crew/epoch/token authority.
DrivingPassFinish retires matching command watch/consent/path journal, with unchanged native receipt required before recall.
DrivingOperationStep exposes PASS phase and existing constrained cadence.
evidence: DrivingAssistStart OBSERVE -> DrivingPassAdmission and DrivingPassStep -> sole cap application
DrivingPassBegin binds current brain and consent
DrivingPassStep phase branches and native issue/return boundaries
